latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of dbt-model-auditor: comprehensive auditing for dbt projects.

- Audits dbt projects for model quality, test coverage, documentation, performance, and best practices.
- Checks naming conventions, ref/source usage, materialization strategy, DAG structure, and model contracts.
- Produces coverage statistics and highlights missing or poor quality tests and documentation.
- Triggers on common dbt audit/review requests.
- Supports detailed reporting on naming, testing, and documentation completeness.
